{{Quote|So far we have prevented the Baron from learning of these infractions. But consider this your last warning! If it happens again, you will be facing immediate demotion.|Official reprimand from Eastern Arch Platoon Leader Ton E'rau, to TK-934|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
'''Ton E'rau''' was the [[Eastern Arch Platoon]] [[Platoon leader/Legends|Leader]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]<ref name="TFUII" /> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of said government's reign. At some point between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="date">The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was formed during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places in the year [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Since the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' occur in the year [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|tie-in comic]], we can conclude that Ton E'rau was alive during that time.</ref> E'rau gave an official reprimand to [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[TK-934]] for the fact that several [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in TK-934's unit were doing activities at the [[Infinite Nebstar Casino]] that were against regulations. Although E'rau made a statement about thus far managing to keep the information from [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]],<ref name="TFUII" /> who was in control of Imperial operations on Cato Neimoidia,<ref name="TFUIIgame">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref> the Platoon Leader threatened to demote TK-934 if there were any further incidents.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ton E'rau was first mentioned in "The [[Infinite Nebstar Casino]]" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'',<ref name="TFUII" /> a [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2010]].<ref name="TFUIIgame" />
